701:t_009:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I'm sorry, $$次元獣$$s... I have no strength left to fight...」

701:t_010:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I... could not honor the lives I've taken...」

701:t_010:2.en:
$n
「Honoring them matters, too... But if you call yourself a general, you should have looked for what you could do for the living.」

701:t_010:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$いがみ合う双子$$... Is that the answer you've reached after surpassing both hope and despair...?」

701:t_010:4.en:
$n
「...I don't know if it's an answer...」

701:t_010:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$いがみ合う双子$$... The $$悲しみの乙女$$, the $$傷だらけの獅子$$, the $$揺れる天秤$$...」

701:t_010:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Any of you will do. Take my four $$スフィア$$s. You should be able to, now that you've achieved $$真化融合$$.」

701:t_010:7.en:
$n
「...How could I do that to someone who's lost the will to fight...?」

701:t_010:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I've been dealing with Dimension Generals since the $$破界事変$$. This is probably my job.」

701:t_010:11.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$揺れる天秤$$... I thank you for your strong will.」

701:t_010:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Stop it. I don't deserve to hear that from someone whose life I'm about to take.」

701:t_010:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Dimension General $$ヴィルダーク$$... If you meet $$ガイオウ$$, tell him...」

701:t_010:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That we're standing against the future of despair.」

701:t_011:0.en:

「I... could not honor the lives I've taken...」

「...How could I do that to someone who's lost the will to fight...?」

701:t_012:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The cursed wanderer, $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... So you were drawn here by the $$スフィア$$s, too.」

701:t_012:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Dimension General $$ヴィルダーク$$. I will carry on your wishes.」

701:t_012:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's dirty, $$アサキム$$! You're gonna steal the $$スフィア$$s?!」

701:t_012:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'll scavenge corpses or do anything else if it lets me take revenge on them.」

701:t_012:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Either of you will do, as long as you defeat the $$御使い$$s. I leave the rest to you.」

701:t_014:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I've taken back your four $$スフィア$$s.」

701:t_014:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$喜びのアドヴェント$$...!」

701:t_014:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アウストラリス$$... $$アドナキエル・ザ・ジェネラル$$...」

701:t_014:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「In recognition of your past achievements, I took your life without making you suffer.」

701:t_014:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Farewell, $$アドナキエル$$.」

701:t_014:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Don't call me that!」

701:t_014:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am... Dimension General $$ヴィルダーク$$!!」

701:t_015:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You seem dissatisfied, $$アサキム$$.」

701:t_015:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But this is a rightful act. We were the $$スフィア$$s' original owners, after all.」

701:t_015:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I cannot forgive that arrogance...」

701:t_016:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「A wise decision. He knows his own strength.」

701:t_016:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「At any rate, four $$スフィア$$s have now returned to us.」

701:t_016:2.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Are you going to fight us with those $$スフィア$$s' power?」

701:t_016:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You don't understand anything, $n.」

701:t_016:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The $$スフィア$$s' power isn't for fighting. They are for saving this universe.」

701:t_016:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll be waiting, $c. Your power is needed to save the entire universe, too.」

701:t_017:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's no use, $n. He withdrew by teleporting.」

701:t_017:2.en:
$$桂$$
「But appearing before us was his mistake.」

701:t_017:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, return immediately. We'll trace the $$烙印$$ and $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s trail, and pursue him by teleporting ourselves.」

701:t_017:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Just you wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We'll pay you back for everything you've done!」

701:t_017:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Now it's our turn to storm your home!」

701:t_017:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
(So long, $$ヴィルダーク$$... I still can't accept you...)

701:t_017:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
(But I'll fulfill your wish and $$尸空#pilot$$'s by defeating them.)

701:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Just as you can now draw out the power of four $$スフィア$$s, I can draw out $$ザンボット$$'s power now!」

701:t_100:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Are you saying that makes you my equal?」

701:t_100:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「No! I'm stronger than you now!」

701:t_100:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「I fight believing in myself and my machine! There's no way I'll lose to someone who fights while lying to his own heart!」

701:t_100:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I admire that spirit! Come, warrior!!」

701:t_101:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even your sun cannot illuminate this dark $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

701:t_101:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「If the light isn't enough, we'll shine brighter! We'll never stop struggling... never stop growing!」

701:t_101:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「We're different from you! You set your own limits and can only live within them. We won't lose to you!」

701:t_101:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I will teach you! There is power that even that cannot reach!」

701:t_102:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「A president whose workers won't follow him is worthless! Stop calling yourself a Dimension General!」

701:t_102:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I cannot. I bear responsibility for everything I've done to get this far.」
